    42	def octets(text):
    43	    """Map a JSON string onto its octet string (U+0000..U+00FF per octet).
    44	
    45	    Code points above U+00FF cannot denote an octet; they are folded onto a
    46	    control octet that every field rule rejects.
    47	    """
    48	    if isinstance(text, bytes):
    49	        return text
    50	    try:
    51	        return text.encode("latin-1")
    52	    except UnicodeEncodeError:
    53	        out = bytearray()
    54	        for ch in text:
    55	            cp = ord(ch)
    56	            out.append(cp if cp <= 0xFF else 0x01)
    57	        return bytes(out)

    60	def is_lower_tchar(byte):
    61	    if 0x61 <= byte <= 0x7A:
    62	        return True
    63	    if 0x30 <= byte <= 0x39:
    64	        return True
    65	    return byte in TCHAR_PUNCT

    81	def valid_field_value(value):
    82	    if not value:
    83	        return True
    84	    if not _value_edge_ok(value[0]) or not _value_edge_ok(value[-1]):
    85	        return False
    86	    for byte in value[1:-1]:
    87	        if not _value_edge_ok(byte) and byte not in (0x20, 0x09):
    88	            return False

    92	def valid_path(path):
    93	    """Origin-form (or '*') path check; the path must not be decoded."""
    94	    if path == b"*":
    95	        return True
    96	    if not path or path[0:1] != b"/":
    97	        return False
    98	    if path[0:2] == b"//":
    99	        return False
   100	    index = 0
   101	    length = len(path)
   102	    while index < length:
   103	        byte = path[index]
   104	        if byte == 0x25:  # '%'
   105	            if index + 2 >= length:
   106	                return False
   107	            if path[index + 1] not in HEX_DIGITS or path[index + 2] not in HEX_DIGITS:
   108	                return False
   109	            index += 3
   110	        elif byte in PATH_PLAIN:
   111	            index += 1
   112	        else:
   113	            return False
   114	    return True
